content: Meningitis caused by methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) should be treated with the following regimens: 1. Preferred regimen for adults: Administer vancomycin at a dosage of 30–45 mg per kilogram of body weight per day, delivered intravenously every 8 to 12 hours, for a duration of 2 weeks. 2. Alternative regimen for adults: Linezolid at a dose of 600 mg, administered either orally or intravenously, every 12 hours. Alternatively, trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole (TMP-SMX) at a dosage of 10–20 mg of trimethoprim per kilogram of body weight per day, delivered intravenously every 6 to 12 hours. 3. Pediatric regimen: Vancomycin at a dosage of 15–20 mg per kilogram of body weight, administered intravenously every 6 hours. Alternatively, linezolid at a dose of 10 mg per kilogram of body weight, administered either orally or intravenously, every 8 hours.
